data.name: Dance Floor VR
data.detailed_description:
Dance Floor VR is an immersive, active VR rhythm game where you step onto glowing tiles, follow the beat, build combos, and dance through genre-themed arenas packed with music, lights, badges, and score-chasing challenges.

Whether you want a quick rhythm challenge or a longer dance-floor session, Dance Floor VR turns simple movement into a colorful, replayable VR experience.

Move, Step, Score

Follow the highlighted tiles and step in time with the music. Each successful move increases your score and keeps your rhythm going, while missed steps challenge you to recover and stay on beat.

The controls are simple to understand, making the game easy to start, while higher levels increase the speed, timing challenge, and visual intensity.

Explore Genre-Themed Arenas

Dance through music-inspired environments with their own style and atmosphere:

  • Electro Pop — Neon City Lights

  • EDM / Cyber Rave — Underground Laser Club

  • Hip-Hop — Graffiti Battle Rooftops

  • Synthwave — Retro Pixel Arcade

Each genre includes progression levels with increasing speed and challenge.

The Steam version also includes additional themed dance-floor content, including Christmas, Party, and Neon arenas, bundled together as part of the full game.

Build Combos and Unlock Badges

Keep your rhythm steady to trigger glowing combo chains and unlock achievement-style badges, including Combo King, Sync Master, Rhythm Explorer, and Beat Champion.

Bonus Finale Stage

Complete the core challenges to unlock a hidden snow-themed finale stage with its own rhythm, atmosphere, and difficulty.

Designed for Active VR Play

Dance Floor VR is built for players who enjoy movement-based VR gameplay, rhythm challenges, glowing visuals, and score-chasing replayability.

Features

  • Immersive VR rhythm gameplay

  • Step-based glowing tile challenges

  • 4 music genres

  • 12 progression levels

  • Christmas, Party, and Neon content included

  • Combo and badge system

  • Dynamic lights and visual feedback

  • Score-chasing arcade gameplay

  • Designed for SteamVR-compatible headsets and tracked motion controllers

  • VR-only standing or room-scale experience

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: OpenXR / SteamVR-compatible VR headset and motion controllers required
  • Additional Notes: VR-only. Standing or room-scale play area recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: OpenXR / SteamVR-compatible VR headset and motion controllers required
  • Additional Notes: VR-only. Standing or room-scale play area recommended.
